command:
mkdir -p /etc/nginx/tls
cat > /usr/local/bin/renew-cert.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
CERT_DIR=/etc/nginx/tls
KEY=$CERT_DIR/server.key
CRT=$CERT_DIR/server.crt
NEW_KEY=$CERT_DIR/server.key.new
NEW_CRT=$CERT_DIR/server.crt.new

need_renew=1
if [ -f "$CRT" ]; then
  # renew if cert expires within 120 seconds (short-lived demo certs)
  if openssl x509 -in "$CRT" -checkend 120 -noout >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    need_renew=0
  fi
fi

if [ "$need_renew" = "1" ]; then
  openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes \
    -keyout "$NEW_KEY" -out "$NEW_CRT" \
    -days 1 -subj "/CN=node1.cert-rotation.local" \
    -addext "subjectAltName=IP:$NODE_IP,DNS:node1" >/tmp/renew-cert.log 2>&1
  mv "$NEW_KEY" "$KEY"
  mv "$NEW_CRT" "$CRT"
  chmod 640 "$KEY"
  chown root:nginx "$KEY" "$CRT" 2>/dev/null || true
  # reload nginx to pick up the new cert without dropping connections
  systemctl reload nginx
  echo "$(date -Is) renewed, notAfter=$(openssl x509 -in "$CRT" -noout -enddate)" >> /var/log/renew-cert.log
fi
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/renew-cert.sh
echo done

command:
cat > /usr/local/bin/renew-cert.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
CERT_DIR=/etc/nginx/tls
. "$CERT_DIR/node.env"
KEY=$CERT_DIR/server.key
CRT=$CERT_DIR/server.crt
NEW_KEY=$CERT_DIR/server.key.new
NEW_CRT=$CERT_DIR/server.crt.new

need_renew=1
if [ -f "$CRT" ]; then
  # renew once fewer than 180s of validity remain (certs are deliberately short-lived
  # so automatic rotation can be observed within a short test window)
  if openssl x509 -in "$CRT" -checkend 180 -noout >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    need_renew=0
  fi
fi

if [ "$need_renew" = "1" ]; then
  NOT_AFTER=$(date -u -d "+6 minutes" +%y%m%d%H%M%SZ)
  openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes \
    -keyout "$NEW_KEY" -out "$NEW_CRT" \
    -not_after "$NOT_AFTER" -subj "/CN=node1.cert-rotation.local" \
    -addext "subjectAltName=IP:$NODE_IP,DNS:node1" >/tmp/renew-cert.log 2>&1
  mv "$NEW_KEY" "$KEY"
  mv "$NEW_CRT" "$CRT"
  chmod 640 "$KEY"
  chown root:nginx "$KEY" "$CRT" 2>/dev/null || true
  # reload nginx to pick up the new cert without dropping in-flight connections
  systemctl reload nginx
  echo "$(date -Is) renewed, serial=$(openssl x509 -in "$CRT" -noout -serial), notAfter=$(openssl x509 -in "$CRT" -noout -enddate)" >> /var/log/renew-cert.log
fi
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/renew-cert.sh
sh -n /usr/local/bin/renew-cert.sh && echo SYNTAX_OK
